head: 6c0929a47f24b6b7e2db18eb1bbe53c9246c9fc6
claim: With the TakeOne switch on, a task recorded as a product demo-video task is refused at merge until its receipt carries a takeone receipt line; with the switch off nothing is checked

target.version: juggernaut bin/jg-brief.sh and bin/jg-merge-gate-lib.sh at this commit

steps.start: a disposable juggernaut home with the TakeOne switch off
steps: scaffold a yes brief with the switch off and run the gate
turn the switch on with config/takeone-demo and scaffold briefs with demo call yes, no and none
run the demo gate on a yes task with no receipt, a receipt without a line, a first-draft line only, and a takeone receipt line
run the gate on a no task and on a task with no recorded call
steps.result: with the switch off nothing is checked; with it on, the yes task is refused until its receipt carries a takeone receipt line; the no task passes; the older task warns and passes
